paite: Asik in atapa Jehoshaphat alal a, Israel mite dou ding in akihihhat hi.
heading: Kumpipa In Jehoshaphat Apang
english: Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his place, and strengthened himself against Israel.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam a kulh nei khopi tengteng ah sepaih akoih a; Judah gam leh apa Asa in ana lak Ephraim gam a khuate ah galvilmi akoih hi.
english: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

paite: Huan Jehoshaphat kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; Baal zong lou a, apu David in atot masaksa lampi tawn a,
english: Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,

paite: apipute uh Pathian zong a, Israel mite hih bang hih lou a, athupiakte azuih zawk ziak in.
english: but sought the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not in the ways of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N akhut ah agam ahihkip a, huchi in Judah gammi tengteng in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, ahong hau in athupi hiaihiai hi.
english: Therefore Yahweh established the kingdom in his hand. All Judah brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and he had riches and honor in abundance.

paite: TOUPA lam ah alungsim a-awn a, Judah gam a kipan mun sangte leh Asherahte aphiatmang vek hi.
english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh. Furthermore, he took away the high places and the Asherah poles out of Judah.

paite: Kum thum avaihawm kum in amilian Benhail, Obadiah, Zekariah, Nathanael, Mikaiah, Judah gam khuate a mite sinsak ding in asawlkhia a;
english: Also in the third year of his reign he sent his princes, even Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah, to teach in the cities of Judah;

paite: Levi mi, Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, Tobadonijah atel tei ua, siampu Elishama leh Jehoramte leng atel uhi.
english: and with them Levites, even Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tobadonijah, the Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, the priests.

paite: TOUPA Dan Bu atawi ua, Judah gam ah asinsak ua, Judah gam khua tengteng tawn in mite asinsak uhi.
english: They taught in Judah, having the book of Yahweh’s law with them. They went about throughout all the cities of Judah and taught among the people.

paite: Huchi in Judah gam leh akim gam tengteng a mite'n TOUPA laudan asiam ua, kuamah in Jehoshaphat adou ngam kei uhi.
heading: Jehoshaphat Thupina
english: The fear of Yahweh fell on all the kingdoms of the lands that were around Judah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

paite: Philistia mi khenkhat in Jehoshaphat kipahman ahong pia ua, siah ding in dangkasik leng ape lai uh; Arabia mite'n ganhon, belamtal sangsagih-le-zasagih leh keltal sangsagih-le-zasagih ahon kai uhi.
english: Some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents and silver for tribute. The Arabians also brought him flocks: seven thousand seven hundred rams and seven thousand seven hundred male goats.

paite: Huchi in Jehoshaphat ahong thupi mahmah a, Judah gam ah kulhte leh thil koihkhawmna khuate abawl a, Judah gam khuate ah nasep tampi anei hi.
english: Jehoshaphat grew great exceedingly; and he built fortresses and store cities in Judah.

paite: Jerusalem ah sepaih mihat hangsante ahau behlap lai hi.
english: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.

paite: A-inkuankuan ua a-omdan uh hichibang ahi: Judah inkuan a sangkhat heutute, heutu Adnah in mihat hangsan nuaithum aheu hi.
english: This was the numbering of them according to their fathers’ houses: From Judah, the captains of thousands: Adnah the captain, and with him three hundred thousand mighty men of valor;

paite: Azom Jehohanan in nuainih-le-singgiat aheu hi.
english: and next to him Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred eighty thousand;

paite: Azom nawn Zikri tapa Amasiah bel kiphaltak a TOUPA a ding a kipia in, mihat hangsan nuainih aheu hi.
english: and next to him Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself to Yahweh, and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.

paite: Benjamin inkuante mihat hangsan Eliada in thal leh lum zangmi nuainih aheu hi.
english: From Benjamin: Eliada, a mighty man of valor, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield;

paite: Azom Jehozabad in galkap ding a mansiangsa nuaikhat- le-singgiat aheu hi.
english: and next to him Jehozabad, and with him one hundred eighty thousand ready and prepared for war.

paite: Hiai tengteng Judah gam a kulh nei khopi a kumpipa'n akoihte sim louh akumpipa kiang a om gigete ahi uh.
english: These were those who waited on the king, in addition to those whom the king put in the fortified cities throughout all Judah.
